Mutating library entries have Solidity delegatecall-context guards. Full parameter names/storage layout are not attested.

Pro-rata units use virtual+1 assets/+1e6 shares; token transferred to executor, output measured by destination balance delta and capped against executor returned amount. Tax/rebase changes are not hidden by nominal amounts.

Close fee25bps of proceeds; liquidation-reason branches additionally100bps penalty, half floor50% insurance and remainder feeRouter. Net liquidation proceeds retire debt; voluntary partial sales retire proportional debt. Full sale/voluntary shortfall may seize posted wsNET with ceil credit conversion capped to margin. Uncovered voluntary exit reverts. Pot receives wsNET, no wsNET market sale. Retires notional/cap shares proportionally; loss to pot not all attributed to borrower.

Lister may supply route; trader route allowed only for borrower-directed branch. Others use canonical pool route; non-trader borrower-close fallback has600-second last-touch check. Do not confuse this route fallback delay with documented300-second under-maintenance persistence.

Calls distributor record(trader,credited seized-margin USDG*1e12) only for nonzero actual credited borrower loss; pot uncovered shortfall excluded. Low-level CALL failure emits failure event and does not revert settlement. No claim retry or backfill guarantee established.
